title: a Duration has no unit constructors
purpose: Duration(seconds is rat) is the only constructor; `Duration(minutes: 5)` names no constructor.

provenance.expected_basis: time/duration (#1018, owner decision of 2026-11-23 on #1005): one canonical constructor, Duration(seconds is rat); the unit constructors were removed, minutes are written as `(5 * 60).rat()` seconds.
